# POST /api/v1/markup

Renders a markup document as HTML supporting multiple modes (markdown, comment, wiki, file, gfm)

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** none · **ID:** `ep-008`

## Request

**Headers:** `Content-Type`

**Request Body** (`application/json`) — `structs.MarkupOption`

| Field | Type | Required | Validation |
|-------|------|----------|------------|
| `Text` | string | True |  |
| `Mode` | string | False | one of: empty/markdown, gfm, comment, wiki, file |
| `Context` | string | False |  |
| `Wiki` | bool | False | deprecated, use Mode=wiki |
| `FilePath` | string | False |  |

## Response

**200** — text/html

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `body` | string | Rendered HTML |

- **422** — Unsupported render mode or invalid argument
- **500** — Internal rendering error

## Workflow

| Step | Module | Component | Type | Details |
|------|--------|-----------|------|---------|
| 1 | [routers](../modules/routers.md) | misc.Markup | controller | Extract form via web.GetForm; Determine mode (wiki deprecated flag overrides); Call common.RenderMarkup |
| 2 | [routers](../modules/routers.md) | common.RenderMarkup | utility | Parse urlPathContext to extract owner/repo/ref/tree; Create appropriate RenderContext based on mode; Call markdown.RenderRaw (for empty/markdown mode) or markup.Render (for other modes) |
| 3 | [modules](../modules/modules.md) | markup.Render | utility | Detect markup renderer by reader content; Render with detected renderer; Sanitize output HTML |

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Markup Wiki flag is deprecated; if Wiki=true, mode is set to 'wiki' overriding Mode field | business_logic | form.Wiki == true |
| Markup mode must be one of: empty, markdown, gfm, comment, wiki, file | validation | mode not in recognized set |

- **util.ErrInvalidArgument from renderer** → ctx.HTTPError → 422
- **Internal render error** → ctx.HTTPError → 500
